name: Kimino Yotsuba
source:
A shy girl who recently transferred to the school.
She has poor communication skills and is timid, and has the dangerous qualities of a small animal.

Her personality is the polar opposite of Hina's, but for some reason they get along well. She
also has excellent grades, and the English version of the Yugahara Ryokan website was created by her.
